Stock assets opening, consider revising

Also, look for a plug in to fix the audio delay.   
Opening first chest "20G were found." Consider revising.   
Bookshelf text has every word capitalized. Consider revising.   
"**Me and Old Man Barry** find a lot of these things...." perhaps just "We" or "Me and the old man"  or "Me and Barry"  
The book in the first room has irregular capitalization, and it's unclear from the choices and dialogue if the character is reading or writing.   
Capitalization is inconsistent with every interact-able item.

Buildings need doors.  
Old Man Barry conversation, the text cuts off.

items.title: I will find you, Jon.
items.text: I will find you, Jon.
The Gamers threatened to rise, there was no other way to preserve the union.

**Areas of Strength:** Excellent job utilizing eventing. You keep the pace of your game up and thus preventing tedium. I get it's for a class, but that doesn't mean boring, so good job in making sure your player stays active.   
**Areas for Improvement:** Always consider creating your own art for the title. Also, change the default font. It helps an amazing amount.   
You took away the option menu, do be careful with that.   
It's a little to railroady, less of a game and more of an interactive powerpoint. Have some more fun with the engine. Or at least change the ways the test iss presented friendo.   
Also, you bring up how long it takes for this process, maybe consider adding an in game clock, just a bit more pizzazz.   
The mapping is a little haphazard. 2nd level titles don't transition well together, makes the map look messy.   
**Overall:** Little low on the entertainment element of edu-tainment, but good job in finishing the project and trying to make something creative. With that in mind however, do make sure to edit your maps and try to add more elements of being a game to it.   


&#x200B;

Hope this  helps, keep creating.
